assumptions: Real EDO106K tabulated bottom with piecewise linear interpolation; vertical sides, flat deck and end/step faces assumed.
Synthetic component masses, not the historical aircraft; constrained surge/sway/roll/yaw.
Zero speed, still mean water and zero mean air flow; no propulsion or flight integration.
Added mass per length = pi*rho*waterline_halfwidth^2/2, an assumed strip proxy, not a 2.5D BEM result.
Modal damping ratio 0.12 is a declared assumption, not fitted to experiment.
Wave excitation is hydrostatic elevation forcing with deep-water phase, without diffraction/radiation memory.
Linear small-amplitude heave/pitch about solved nonlinear hydrostatic equilibrium; no step ventilation or impact.
